start_here: Say to your AI: "Show the reels and transformations on my site." It runs tool:read-the-clips-published-to-a-site and shows strips of stills that play on tap.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it reads the clips the pursuit database has published to its own site and changes nothing.
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit database that holds the recording moments, such as example_for_who_runs_it; the computer opens it with the read login its vault holds, under the use publish on the site.
2. Say what you want in plain words; your AI calls tools:run with tool tool:read-the-clips-published-to-a-site and the input.
3. Read the answer: the clips with their files at the site's own addresses. Show it with the screen the tool names.
